notes.text: The sound controls for scenes in preview mode do not reflect actual selected playlists or volumes (they show "Main" and a full volume control, for example, even when at locations with custom music sound tracks like Casa Loma)
When the pink player right-clicks her Tarot control to automatically draw a card, position that card one world unit above the deck and let it drop into place
The NPC sheets appear to be twice as wide as they should be (i.e. twice as wide as both normal CSHEET objects put together, instead of being equal to them in size)
